bullets.text: The monitoring officer and collector inspected the Pulicat coastal area following the Murasu cyclone sign, and the office should monitor storm preparedness updates closely.
Owners staged a protest by parking sewage vehicles inside the Gummidipoondi block development office, and the office should watch for local administration updates on this issue.
Corning expanded Pune optical manufacturing for the AI data center market and its Chennai cover-glass plant began operations, so the office should track state manufacturing growth.
Global AI stock sell-offs due to ROI concerns put Indian IT companies in focus, and the office should monitor market trends affecting domestic service providers.
US cloud provider Vultr plans to scale Indian AI compute capacity to 1 GW by 2029, and the office should engage with infrastructure investments in Chennai.
